o1.biggest_strength: It finds the three real leaks in the data and ranks them well: WISMO silence, low fit-finder use, and a refund-biased returns portal.
o1.biggest_mistake: It invents a November/Christmas timeline and its day-3 message only goes to parcels with a courier scan, which misses part of the silence causing tickets.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Remove the invented calendar, add a proper post-delivery fit help message for first-time bra buyers, and report retained swaps as gross profit or clearly as revenue only.

o2.biggest_strength: It turns the data into a practical 60-day flow with ready-to-send copy, the right portal changes, holdout measurement, and realistic ranges.
o2.biggest_mistake: It treats swap value mostly as sales kept rather than gross profit and adds SMS without covering consent or cost.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add gross-profit assumptions for swaps, tighten the SMS/legal note, and make the day-3 message work cleanly even when there is no courier scan yet.

reason: Output 2 is the one I could hand to CRM, CX and web tomorrow: the copy is more complete, it includes the first-bra fit check and post-delivery fit nudge, and the numbers are easier to read. Output 1 is strong, but the invented dates and weaker day-3 handling would need more editing.
